notes.title: v2.2.3 Steam update
notes.notes:
Huddle up sports fans, a new controller is on the field. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/db5835ccd8e42094cbaa124d1fefa56478e73548.png[/img]

PC players get improved support for a larger number of game controllers, including the Sony DualSense controller, in the latest update. All though the controllers worked fine, proper controller icons are now shown on screen for the DualSense controller (DualShock 4 support was already included).  To make this possible, SSDT 2.2.3 for PC brings an updated Rewired controller library. A few minor things were cleaned up and fixed along the way, so the version number has jumped a bit.

v2.2.3 for Windows: Rewired updated, Dual Sense glyph support, QoL keyboard mouse text updates, Minor text fixes for season mode player select, Camera scroll fix (introduced in Steam Deck update)

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.notes: This update is for the Steam Deck owners. Take SSDT with you on the go! The Steam Deck handles the game great, and now Super Slam Dunk Touchdown looks like it was made for the portable device. This build is 16:10 optimized while still making the most of ultrawide monitors on PC. You get full Steam Deck controller support and touch screen support for most UI elements. Happy sportsballing!

notes.title: Things just got a little easier
notes.notes:
After fixing an AI bug, the AI was too good! The difficulty was ramping up to hard. It is now much friendlier and even cuts you some slack on some of the "shadier" challenges.

Secret CPU v CPU mode now randomizes the difficulty of each time for more entertaining viewing.

notes.title: EXTRA SEASONING UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]Huddle up![/h1]

The Extra Seasoning update brings loads of new content for 1-3 players either locally or with Steam's Remote Play feature.  Classic 6 player modes available too, along with upgraded CPU players.

[h2]Season Mode[/h2]

Assemble your dream team by defeating unique Soccer, Hockey, Football, Roller Derby, Basketball and Baseball teams, earning fans, making money and playing season after season. Master each player in 6 all new training games! Unlock new player colors, new balls, new game options, and more by discovering the secrets in this endless looping campaign that adjusts difficulty automatically as you progress. Track your stats, earn fans and stack cash to customize your home arena. With a dozen different season endings, there is a lot of new content to discover! 

[h2]Steam or Stream[/h2]

With multiple controller modes, you can play in many different ways. Play with an old Gamecube controller or a modern Xbox controller and just about any analog joystick in between. Use Xinput for modern features, Direct Input for legacy compatibility, a combination of both, and more. With a new windowed screen mode, you can stream the game more easily. Keyboard and mouse is also supported (not recommended).

[h2]AI, UI, UX improvements[/h2]

Virtually every aspect of the game has been improved since the 2017 Pre-Season update. Controller diagrams, scoring diagrams, simplified controls, better computer players, and a guided Season Mode journey to help you master the game. Cloud saves supported too!

[h2]Reach for the Chievos[/h2]

All 100 Xbox achievements are here and only the best and boldest players will unlock them all. You can even reset them and challenge yourself again and again for a sense of pride and accomplishment. Touchdown!

notes.title: Extra Seasoning: Open Beta
notes.notes:
Some stats bugs have emerged during testing that will take a bit more time to fix. With the holidays here in the USA in full swing, rather than make you wait, the beta is being opened to all! 

You can play the all new Season Mode with 1-3 players and anyone who owns the game can host a Steam Remote play session with friends (recommended 30+mbps upspeed). Your friends don't need to own the game to play the game or the open beta! There are still 1-6 player classic modes as well as secret unlocks, Season Mode training games and 100 achievements.  

Please leave feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/388260/discussions/0/3008934419472058784/]in the forums[/url]. Tipping Goat hopes you have all the happy holidays!

notes.title: Extra Seasoning Development Update
notes.notes:
[h2]PC Power![/h2]

The power of the PC platform is in the performance of the peripherals! Super Slam Dunk Touchdown can be played with just about whatever analog joystick you have laying around the house for up to 6 players locally. It makes doing the platform justice challenging and Super Slam Dunk Touchdown will be going the extra 110%! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/63917da40993919e8894f8d9a3d013a04f57083f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/c86b95291618abbdb0ea89a9f35d3eb846e4df37.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Steam Stream Dream Team[/h2]

Steam's Remote Play feature is awesome! That's why the still-in-development Extra Seasoning update is getting more controller modes to help make sure everyone can have a good experience whether streaming, playing with friends remotely, or in person.

Players will be able to choose the input mode that is right for their unique set up: Whether pure Xinput for maximum compatibility with Xbox controllers and Steam or a Direct Input mode that allows 6 controllers of any type with or without Xinput enabled. Once the Extra Seasoning update hits, there will be a new option for Controller Mode on the Option menu.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/197f35db520ab6584648339b0e68640e7230bbc9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/94bf426039dbb348c4309be561a28da708e9714d.jpg[/img]WIP[/url] 

[h2]Can't control yourself?[/h2]

Each input mode brings with it customizable controls for each unique joystick name. It can get confusing fast when you have a Playstation controller, a flightstick, a generic PC game controller and an Xbox One controller all with a keyboard and mouse player.  Fortunately, the Extra Seasoning update will come with a "View Controls" option on the in-game pause menu. This new screen shows the controls for each controller in use beside the associated player ##. There's also a visible joystick icon that each player can wiggle if they are trying to figure out who the heck they are.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/ee6671e93de9ad4d41e6b1f722310c7e6df9cba7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/cd5a7bd6b29339d762d57b8550bb02f59782f862.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Still in Progress[/h2]

Tipping Goat can't wait to get this update out to the loyal Steam sports fans. Please pop in to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/388260/discussions/]discussion forums[/url] and say hello! There's still bugs to fix, 100 achievements and more Steam features to support, so stay tuned for the beta announcement, and stay sportsy!

notes.title: Super Slam Dunk Touchdown gets Xbox release date
notes.notes:
[h1]Xbox Release Date: August 27[/h1]

[url=http://tippinggoat.com/blog/2021/08/xbox-release-date-august-27/]Super Slam Dunk Touchdown is teed up for launch August 27, 2021 for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S![/url]

[h2]The Long Game[/h2]

Initially conceived in 2009 as “Sportsball”, Super Slam Dunk Touchdown was revealed to the world as a pre-alpha demo at PAX South way back in 2015. After a lot of work, it launched on Steam’s Early Access and eventually was updated in 2017 with a Pre-Season version that promised more “Coming Soon!”

“Soon” is relative in galactic timescales, and a short few years later is ready for launch on Xbox hardware with extra seasoning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/709eefd3a427026d463d8bc0420432bc84a717c6.png[/img]

[h2]Season Mode[/h2]

In addition to many improvements, tweaks and additions, Super Slam Dunk Touchdown launches on Xbox with the all new Season Mode: A massive 1-3 player co-op campaign that pits your custom team against 6 unique CPU rivals. Tryout your players in 6 new micro training games. Accumulate fans and money in exhibition matches, season matches, the playoffs and finals. Play season after season, earn the respect of your coach and discover multiple endings, hidden unlocks, and 100 achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/aa66d5f81f2da188ac47868fc5d496c524315798.png[/img]

[h2]Windows PC Update Coming to Steam[/h2]

Owners of the Pre-Season version of SSDT can expect a new version in short order after the Xbox Launch. The Extra Seasoning version of SSDT for Steam will support cloud saves, remote play and all 100 achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9744315/d6c9b5759a0fd37e78e67e2fd00d543a07b26a30.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre-Season Update is Here
notes.notes:
Howdy Sports Fans!

After a lot of time and work, I'm happy to announce the Pre-Season Update for Super Slam Dunk Touchdown is finally live. This is a very big update with lots of improvements that paves the way for the Xbox One port and full Season Mode update.  Here's briefly what's in store:

[b]On the surface[/b]
[list]
    [*] Additional sounds and music
    [*] New and improved art and animation, including new arena art
    [*] 3 new achievements
    [*] Players can join mid-game with the shoot button
    [*] Smoother asset loading
    [*] Practice mode tutorial with Coach Clip
    [*] Improved UI
    [*] Much better AI opponents
[/list]

[b]Under the hood[/b]
[list]
    [*] Loads of code was reorganized for Season Mode features
    [*] Tons of testing and bug fixes
    [*] More controller definitions added
    [*] Tweaked random events for crazier streakers and bananas on high setting
[/list]

Thanks for playing! I'm getting right back to work. The Xbox One port and Season Mode await.

notes.title: Announcing the pre-season beta
notes.notes:
Hey sports fan!

Things have been quiet while Tipping Goat has been working on new features, updated art, tweaks and fixes for your favorite all-sports mashup. In addition to all this, a lot of older code has been reworked and will need testing and feedback as we get closer to the official Season Mode update.

To this end, a pre-season beta version of SSDT will be released on Steam that you can opt into. The pre-season beta will include: 

* Updated arenas from Season mode: Play in the classic American football stadium, or change it up with the all new basket ball court, all new practice lot or head over to Canada for the new hockey arena.
* New spotlight celebration for the player who scores
* Live, in-game, per-player scoring stats right on the field
* The controller drives the mouse for easier controller configuration
* Many smaller bug fixes, art updates and more

The pre-season beta will be updated as more features get added, leading up to the Season Mode release.  So stay tuned! Another announcement will be posted when the pre-season beta is ready in the next week or so.

notes.title: SSDT v1.3.3 is here
notes.notes:
Hey there, Sports Fan! 

Rick here, with the latest update to Super Slam Dunk Touchdown. It's live right now! Let's get right to what's in the build:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Partial Spanish language support: Spanish on all UI buttons, player stats and some other UI elements as well.
[*] Lock icon added for locked players in Challenge Mode
[*] CPU levels 2 and 3 are more challenging in Free-For-All mode
[*] American Football player has a greater penalty for missing a tackle
[*] More city and sports team names added to name generator
[*] New "Free-For-All" achievement
[*] If sudden death is on, there is no longer a normal "OVERTIME" round before sudden death kicks in (previous behavior was intentional, but ended up confusing people)
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Can no longer select characters on a team that is full (player icons restricted to the open team's half of the screen)
[*] Title "post-wiggle" fix
[*] CPU players much better at dunking!
[*] Season Mode colors locked (oops!) -- stay tuned for Season Mode later this year!
[*] End game/round "moon walking" and other odd behavior fixed
[*] CPU player icons revert to black & white after removing them from your team
[*] "Pause at game over screen" bug fixed
[*] Scoring glitch fixed in Free-For-All mode
[/list]

That's it! Enjoy the update, and, while you still can: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/388260/discussions/0/412446292760520808/]hop on over to the forums and let me know what features you think are essential to Season Mode![/url]

notes.title: Post-PAX South update
notes.notes:
Howdy, Sports Fan!

Rick here with a quick update on what's going on with SSDT. I am chipping away at my bug list, adding some minor features, and prepping for launch on a new platform!

I'll have details on the new platform launch soon, but until then, here's a sample of what Windows players can look forward to in the next update:

[list]
[*] More advanced AI for higher CPU levels in Free-For-All
[*] No more moon-walking players at the end of a round
[*] Overtime is now either Sudden Death (default setting), or not Sudden Death (optional). No more hard-to-explain "that one overtime round where you can change characters then another X minutes before Sudden Death kicks in if the scores are still tied"
[*] CPU players now dunk more reliably (scales with difficulty setting)
[*] ¡Español! Well, the UI anyway! A fan generously helped out with the Spanish translation of many UI elements. There were some UI adjustments that had to be made to fit some of the text, and some text has to remain in English, at least for now. But hey, it broadens the appeal of the game a bit, and that's good!
[*] Invisible, but important, Season Mode preparations
[/list]

There will be more fixes as well, and I'll [b]try[/b] to get a new achievement into the next update. But with all the fixes coming, I may not be able to wait. More soon!

notes.title: Free Bonus Mini Game and an AI overhaul for Super Slam Dunk Touchdown!
notes.notes:
Howdy Sports Fan!

Rick from Tipping Goat here! I wanted to tell you about the latest version of the wild, retro-styled, team sports mashup: Super Slam Dunk Touchdown (v1.3). The game has been updated with the latest fixes and a [b]free[/b] multiplayer bonus mini game for all customers.

[b]Free-For-All[/b]

The new bonus game is a real rumble royale! It's every sport for itself in this 6 player, frenetic, everyone vs. everyone battle for points! There's one goal with 3 ways to score and no goalie. Go for an easy shot in the open net, or pick a player who can try for a field goal or the hoop for more points. But you aren't alone -- take out any nearby high scoring players, stop them from charging their shots, intercept their balls and get to the point limit before anyone else!

Customize the number of AI players, the AI skill level, the maximum number of points, and even how much the different goals are worth! There's no slam dunks in this mode, so polish up on your favorite player's shooting styles in practice mode. 

The new Free-For-All mini game, the standard 3 vs. 3 quickmatch and the 3 player challenge modes in Super Slam Dunk Touchdown will make a wild and chaotic addition to your local multiplayer game nights.

[b]Upgraded AI[/b]

Tipping Goat has been hard at work rebuilding the pathfinding and shooting for the bot players this year, and the first major revision is out now! The upgraded bot players now hunt you behind the goal, charge up their shots, and shoot more reliably. They take into account the weight of the ball, their distance from the goal, and how they shoot. Additionally, the baseball and basketball bots now take full advantage of their "oddball" shooting styles, making them more worthy adversaries and more reliable teammates. 

[b]PAX South this week[/b]

Come play the latest build with a whole convention full of gamers! 2015 was the first PAX South, and Tipping Goat was the indie surprise hit of the show with a pre-alpha version of Super Slam Dunk Touchdown. Excited gamers lined up all weekend to punt, pass, punch, tackle, slam dunks and exchange high fives. 

Tipping Goat is back for 2016 with the release version, updated with all the latest features and fixes. Stop by the booth to get in on the full 6 player experience, meet Tipping Goat and maybe even win an official SSDT-Shirt! 

If you can't make it to the show, be sure to watch the live Twitch stream from PAX South! I'll be personally demonstrating the game live from the Twitch stage!

Thanks for reading and enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Minigame?
notes.notes:
Howdy Sports Fan,

I wanted to let you know about what Tipping Goat has planned for the next build of Super Slam Dunk Touchdown. Things have been quiet while work is getting done, so here's an update!

[b]Upgraded AI[/b]

While the CPU players always have room for improvement, this next build will feature a completely overhauled pathfinding system and long awaited, across-the-board AI improvements. Look for more formidible opponents, better buddies, and fewer exploits. Also, the CPU difficulty levels will get some extra attention.

[b]Features and fixes[/b]

I won't list them all here, but a slightly cooler title sequence will be your clue that you've got the new build. And, I might as well get to it, the biggest new feature is...

[b]Minigame?[/b]

notes.title: Release day is here... It's Game Time!
notes.notes:
Grab a couch and five friends, because Super Slam Dunk Touchdown is here to take local multiplayer gaming and punt a home run! Pick your team from Soccer, Hockey, American Football, Roller Derby, Basketball and Baseball players. Each type of player plays their own way, but they all play together, and everyone can slam dunk!

[b]Retro Roots[/b]

SSDT is an all-sports mashup in the spirit of the irreverent classic 8 and 16 bit sports titles of yesteryear. It's a return the days when sports games were more about fun than realism, when social gaming meant hanging out with other people in the same room, and when you didn't need to learn 12 buttons to play a game.

[b]Modern Technology[/b]

Powered by 3D physics, SSDT mixes crazy arcade action with the latest in [i]Sports Science![/i] Hockey pucks don't behave the same way on turf as bowling balls do on ice. Each player throws, kicks or hits the ball like they would in their own sport: American Football players toss spirals, hockey players make slap shots, and basketball players shoot for the hoop. The spin on the ball, the weight of the ball, the friction, bounciness and shape of the ball, as well as the surface you're playing on all make a difference.

[b]Arcade Action[/b]

There's no rules in Super Slam Dunk Touchdown. Just get the ball into the net, hoop or past the uprights to score the most goal points! Use teamwork, strategy, and violence to get the advantage: Defend your ball carrier, fake out the goalie, tackle a streaker, pass, punt and punch your way to sports victory!

[b]Now available![/b]

Available now on Steam, Super Slam Dunk Touchdown supports 1-6 players locally. Game controllers are supported as well as keyboard and mouse controls. Steam Controller and Steam Streaming supported with X-Input enabled.

notes.title: State of the Build
notes.notes:
Howdy sports fans,

It's getting to be crunch time at Tipping Goat, and some big outstanding TODOs are getting checked off. There won't be a new build until I get the new features in, but here's what you have to look forward to with the next few builds:

[b]Updated UI[/b]

The current UI is a cheap and dirty menu system I wrote at the start of the project. Since then, Unity has come out with a new UI system (one that you've seen on the team selection screen) and I've been working to change over most of the old menus to the new UI. Here's the new UI feature list, and most of this is complete:

[list]
[*] Menus are mouse, keyboard, touch or joystick driven
[*] Mouse cursor for UI added
[*] Better Options menu with plus/minus buttons and checkboxes
[*] Overhauled controller configuration menus
[/list]

[b]Controller Config Overhaul[/b]

Speaking of, this screen needs its own feature list! I have completed all the joystick controller config changes, and am starting on custom keyboard controls. Here's what to expect:

[list]
[*] Independently set the primary and secondary buttons
[*] Added an independent Back button for menu navigation (pass will still work in this regard)
[*] New default controls for many types of sticks, following the controller's own definition of Shoot/Pass = Accept/Cancel (generally A, B or X, O in the case of playstation). Turbo has been moved to "R1" or the upper-right shoulder button in most cases. Swap remains Y (or Triangle).
[*] New Deadzone setting for each stick.
[*] Customizable keyboard controls, finally! This took a while because A) I needed a new UI and B) playing with the keyboard is a bad experience. B may finally be addressed as I have added a new way to play with the keyboard...
[*] Mouse customization! Keyboard controls will have the option of aiming and shooting with the mouse. 
[/list]

[b]And speaking of mouse control...[/b]

The keyboard + mouse control works how you might expect: 

[list]
[*] The keyboard moves 
[*] Hold down the mouse button to aim. Then, drag the mouse in the direction you want to shoot and let go when ready. 
[*] When the mouse is not in use, the keyboard controls behave in the default manner.
[/list]

Needless to say all this is quite a bit of work, but it is coming along nicely.

[b]What about the Steam controller?[/b]

Well I have some more information about what the problem with the controller is, and it's really a Steam issue. When the Steam controller is connected to Steam, Steam takes over the interpretation of all joysticks, breaking Direct Input in the process (the lovely legacy controller system that allows 6 players at once in SSDT). Steam probably does this to hide all the real sticks from games so that when streaming a game from another device, Steam can send those joystick inputs through to the host computer and hide all the host computer's controllers. But it only works with Microsoft's newer (and 4-player limited) input system, Xinput.

In order for SSDT to function when a Steam Controller is connected and Steam is running, it must be put into Xinput mode from the options menu. This will limit the number of players to 4 and only allow Xinput controllers (such as the Steam Controller, Xbox 360 or Xbox One controllers). This is an option for this reason; if you want 6 players you would turn Xinput off, and if you want to use the Steam Controller you would have to turn Xinput on.

I am considering a popup if no controllers are detected to help with this.

[b]Bummer[/b]

I know! Tell me all about it -- it's been frustrating me since I got the controller. But here's some slightly more fun facts:

[list]
[*] After the new build is ready, I plan on working on improving the AI
[*] I am still targeting end-of-year for release
[*] New box art is being worked on this very moment
[*] SSDT seems to work with Steamlink (when in Xinput mode). More testing is needed.
[/list]

That's a long update, so I'll get back to work!

notes.title: The latest
notes.notes:
Howdy, and apologies for the lack of a new build recently. I've been holding off on posting a new one until I can address one of the more glaring issues still outstanding. 

What I've been seeing is new players stuck in 0-0 matches going overtime endlessly. To partially deal with this, I want to implement a Sudden Death Overtime feature where the next point wins the game. For one, it takes away the time limit, and people will have time to score before time runs out. But I am also seeking a way to deal with the goalie situation in Sudden Death Overtime -- I'd rather not eliminate them completely but I'm playing with some ideas. 

To further address this I'll need a couple other features in place, but they are larger than anyone should have to wait for the next build. Hopefully this feature will make the game friendlier for new players. When the new update is ready it will also go out with a new random event that I think you all will like. The event is in place now and just needs art at this point.

I hope everyone has been enjoying the current build, and if you're struggling against the AI, I recommend practicing shots in Shot Practice mode, and for the love of all that is precise, use a controller with an analog stick to play :) 

There will eventually be a tutorial, but that's a bit further down the road.

notes.title: Version 1.4.8a is now live
notes.notes:
Check out the discussions forum for details, but the two highlights are: Team Color Selection and the Always Control Ball Carrier game option.

[b]Team Color Selection:[/b] Choose from 4 different unlocked color palettes (for now) for each team by clicking on either "HOME TEAM" or "AWAY TEAM" on the team selection screen. Add some personalitity to your team and some more color to your screen shots!

[b]Always Control Ball Carrier:[/b] On the team selection screen, click the OPTIONS button, then click CPU. You can enable Control Ball Carrier there. When this is enabled, one of the human players on each team will automatically control any CPU player that picks up the ball. It's an "auto switch" feature ideal for single human teams. The player icon now flies from one player to the next to better communicate player switching.
